title: Baked Brown Sugar French Toast
ingredients: Thick white bread, slightly stale (brioche or challah recommended)
instructions: Line a sheet pan with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Melt 1 cup brown sugar with 1 stick of butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently until smooth. Pour onto the sheet pan and spread into an even layer.
Whisk together a standard French toast batter: milk or cream, eggs, sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla.
Dip each bread slice in the batter on both sides, then arrange the slices in an even layer on top of the brown sugar mixture on the sheet pan.
Bake at 375 F for about 30 minutes.
notes: Originally from Instagram creator @eatbasilandbloom; featured by Allrecipes. Use a thick bread like brioche or challah, slightly stale so it soaks up the custard better.
